posts.author_bio: Teaching builders how to extract and use information from documents to make better, faster decisions
posts.post_caption:
Docling added an AFP reader. I tested it on two public sample files: one gave me searchable phrases like "C++ compiler," with some garbled characters. The second was mostly unreadable.

The reader has an encoding limitation and only extracts text. Even with those limits, it's a useful start.

More document news: https://isaacflath.com/news
